scene: The radish glows spicy-hot, illuminating three departing transit portals!
picture: Flat side view. The player stands centre-left holding her red umbrella and a glowing, half-eaten radish. On the far left, a subway train waits at an open illuminated platform hatch. At the centre sits an idling yellow street tram on tracks. On the far right, a harbour ferry floats ready in an aqueduct canal.
shown: A gleaming underground train waiting at an open platform hatch on the far left.
A jaunty yellow cable tram parked on rooftop tracks at the centre.
A colourful ferry docked beside a roof canal chute on the far right.

variants.scene: The radish blazes brightly in your hands as three rides wait to leave.
Warm firelight shines across the garden roof, showing three ways to travel onward.
Sparks crackle from your spicy snack, revealing three vehicles ready to depart.
